<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) where a halide is replaced by an amine. Use the precursor SMILES from the previous step as the molecule input and filter for templates that break a “halide” functional group and form an “amine” functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
